verdict.rationale: The official README shows a 'Run and chat with Gemma 4' terminal example, and a community benchmark confirms hands-on use of the 'ollama run' CLI command (with --verbose) to chat with a local model. Together these show the core story: starting a chat with a model from the terminal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the interactive REPL session (in-session commands, multiline input, session controls), and corroboration that 'ollama run' opens an interactive chat rather than only producing timed output.
